integrity: Analytical polynomial and principal-minor proof; exact rational polynomial checker verify.py supplements rather than replaces proof.
scientific_limitations: Theorem covers real two-dimensional rank-one-damped matrices with a,b>0, constant nonnegative steps and the second-order truncated exponential; nonexpansiveness is in the unweighted Euclidean norm. It does not establish energy monotonicity of all spectral-stable steps or transfer to arbitrary systems. Independent scientific validation not performed.
title: An exact energy-stability phase diagram for explicit midpoint on partially damped planar oscillators
